problem:
Problem description
- There is a planning horizon of $$T$$ months, indexed by $$t \in \mathcal{T} = \{1,2,\ldots,T\}$$.
- A family of rental contract lengths is available, indexed by $$\ell \in \mathcal{L} = \{1,2,\ldots,L\}$$.
- The required warehouse area in month $$t$$ is given by demand data $$d_t$$.
- Rental cost depends on contract length. The unit fee for one billing unit of area under length $$\ell$$ is $$c_\ell$$.
- One billing unit represents an area of $$b$$ square meters.
- A contract of length $$\ell$$, once selected, covers consecutive months starting from month $$1$$ through month $$\ell$$.
- Multiple warehouse contracts may be rented in parallel, and the rented area under each contract length may be chosen in integer billing units.
- The combined rented area available in each month must exactly match that month’s demand, with no shortage and no excess.
- The number of distinct active contract lengths must be at least $$K^{\min}$$ and at most $$K^{\max}$$.
- Some contract lengths may be mutually exclusive; if one length in an incompatible pair is active, the other length in that pair cannot be active as well.
- In the given business rule set, the shortest and longest contract lengths are incompatible.
- The planning goal is to minimize the total rental cost over the full horizon.

- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_\ell$$: the integer number of billing units rented under contract length $$\ell$$.
  - $$y_\ell$$: a binary indicator that equals $$1$$ if contract length $$\ell$$ is used and $$0$$ otherwise.
  - $$Z$$: the total rental cost of the selected rental plan.

Input Format
{
  "T": "integer $$T$$, number of planning months",
  "L": "integer $$L$$, number of available contract lengths",
  "demand": "array $$[d_1,d_2,\ldots,d_T]$$ of length $$T$$, where $$d_t$$ is the required area in month $$t$$",
  "fee_per_billing_unit": "array $$[c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_L]$$ of length $$L$$, where $$c_\ell$$ is the rental fee for one billing unit of area under contract length $$\ell$$",
  "billing_unit_area": "scalar $$b$$, area represented by one billing unit",
  "min_active_lengths": "integer $$K^{\min}$$, minimum number of distinct active contract lengths",
  "max_active_lengths": "integer $$K^{\max}$$, maximum number of distinct active contract lengths",
  "incompatible_length_pairs": "list of pairs $$\left(\ell_1,\ell_2\right)$$ such that both lengths cannot be active at the same time"
}

Output Format
{
  "total_cost": "optimal value $$Z$$ of the rental-cost objective",
  "selected_contracts": [
    {
      "length": "contract length $$\ell$$",
      "quantity": "integer $$x_\ell$$, number of billing units rented under length $$\ell$$",
      "active": "binary $$y_\ell$$, whether length $$\ell$$ is used"
    }
  ]
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "T": 4,
  "L": 4,
  "demand": [1500, 1000, 2000, 1200],
  "fee_per_billing_unit": [4000, 7500, 10500, 13000],
  "billing_unit_area": 100,
  "min_active_lengths": 2,
  "max_active_lengths": 3,
  "incompatible_length_pairs": [[1, 4]]
}

parameters.name: num_planning_months
parameters.description: Number of planning months in the horizon

parameters.name: monthly_demand
parameters.description: Required warehouse area in each month

parameters.name: contract_fee
parameters.description: Fee per billing unit for each contract length

parameters.name: billing_unit_area
parameters.description: Area represented by one billing unit

parameters.name: min_active_lengths
parameters.description: Minimum number of distinct active contract lengths

parameters.name: max_active_lengths
parameters.description: Maximum number of distinct active contract lengths

parameters.name: incompatible_length_pairs
parameters.description: Set of incompatible unordered pairs of contract length indices

variables.name: billing_units_rented
variables.description: Integer number of billing units rented under each contract length

variables.name: contract_length_used
variables.description: Binary indicator equal to 1 if a contract length is active, and 0 otherwise

variables.name: total_rental_cost
variables.description: Total rental cost of the selected rental plan

constraints.name: monthly_demand_coverage
constraints.description: For each month t, the total rented area from all contract lengths covering month t must exactly equal the demand in that month.

constraints.name: contract_length_span_coverage
constraints.description: A contract length contributes coverage only in the months it spans under the 0-based indexing convention

constraints.name: activation_linking
constraints.description: A contract length can be active only if it has positive rented billing units, enforced with a Big-M link using the maximum monthly demand.

constraints.name: active_length_count_bounds
constraints.description: The number of distinct active contract lengths must be between the minimum and maximum allowed values, inclusive.

constraints.name: incompatible_length_pairs
constraints.description: Any pair of incompatible contract lengths cannot both be active at the same time.

constraints.name: shortest_longest_incompatibility
constraints.description: The shortest and longest contract lengths are incompatible and cannot both be active; enforce directly in case the pair is not present in P.

constraints.name: nonnegative_demand_and_cost
constraints.description: Demand and contract fees are nonnegative, and billing unit area is positive.

constraints.name: variable_domains
constraints.description: Billing units rented must be nonnegative integers and contract usage indicators must be binary.

constraints.name: index_and_parameter_bounds
constraints.description: Planning horizon and number of contract lengths are positive integers, and the active-length bounds are valid.

constraints.name: total_cost_definition
constraints.description: Define total rental cost as the linear aggregation of fee per billing unit times the rented billing units.

objectives.name: total_rental_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize the total rental cost of the warehouse rental plan over the full horizon

final_objective.description: Minimize the total rental cost of the warehouse rental plan over the full horizon.
